author: N6rL
content:
Decisions settled in conversation with human. Recording as ADR entries and updating library.rs trait signature.

1. SQLite crate → rusqlite. No async runtime at M1; sqlx offline-mode friction not worth it.
2. Library::get return type → owned KnowledgeObject (Option A). Reference return is a borrow-checker footgun in real usage; all SQL stores return owned data naturally. Change trait signature now before any callers exist.
3. Annotation intake for M1 → Rust binary subcommand (alcanzai annotate). Python CLI wrapper deferred to M2+; M1 only needs to prove §9.4, not build the full interaction layer.
